title: Irene Kitchings, Teddy Wilson's first wife and composer
summary: Dance reports that Irene Kitchings died last year. Humes planned to record her songs such as 'It's the Little Things That Mean So Much'. Dance recalls Irene's own group in Chicago and then raises Roger Kellaway.
